Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2025-10-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify). Choose exactly one label from: AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Return ONLY this JSON object and nothing else: {{"decision": "<one label>", "confidence": <integer 1-5>, "rationale": "<=25 words"}}
raw_response: {"decision":"BBB-","confidence":3,"rationale":"Strong profitability (48% op margin) and adequate liquidity (current ratio 1.55), but high leverage (liabilities ~79% of assets) limits stability."}
